title: Prompt Cancellations of Microsoft 365 Subscriptions: Licenses Refunded as Never Used
content:
On a Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) subscription, how the license refund is worked out depends on how promptly the subscription is given up.

**A. Cancelled promptly after the window opened.** The cancellation date is no more than three calendar days after the date the cancellation window opened. The licenses are refunded as never used. The license refund is the cycle amount per license times the licenses refunded, with no day count.

**B. Cancelled promptly after the latest seat addition.** This case needs all three of the following:

- the cancellation comes more than three days after the window opened;
- it comes no more than three calendar days after the latest seat addition;
- that seat addition carries a partial-cycle charge.

The licenses that seat addition added are refunded as never used: their partial-cycle charge is returned in full. The other licenses held are refunded at the cycle amount per license, times those other licenses, times the calendar days from the cancellation date through the last day of the cycle inclusive, divided by the days in the cycle. The license refund is the sum of the two.

**C. Any other cancellation.** No prompt-cancellation basis applies.

The window's opening date, the latest seat addition, its quantity and its partial-cycle charge are read from the subscription's records and billing ledger.

## Case table

| Days from window opening date to cancellation date | Days from latest seat addition to cancellation date | That addition carries a partial-cycle charge | Case |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 to 3 | any | any | A |
| 4 or more | 0 to 3 | yes | B |
| 4 or more | 0 to 3 | no | C |
| 4 or more | 4 or more, or no seat addition | — | C |

## Hypothetical illustrations (cycle amount per license 120.00 USD, cycle of 365 days)

1. The window opened on 1 March and 20 licenses are cancelled on 4 March, 3 days later. This is case A: 120.00 times 20, which is 2400.00.
2. The window opened on 1 March. A seat addition of 5 licenses on 10 March carries a partial-cycle charge of 580.00. All 20 licenses held are cancelled on 12 March, with 354 days left in the cycle. This is case B:
   - 580.00 for the 5 added licenses;
   - plus 120.00 times 15 times 354, divided by 365, which is 1745.75342;
   - for a license refund of 2325.75342.
